sources.title: Four-stroke engine
sources.quote: A four-stroke (also four-cycle) engine is an internal combustion engine (ICE or IC engine) in which the piston completes four separate strokes while turning the crankshaft.

claims.text: Langkah hisap menurunkan piston untuk menarik campuran udara dan bahan bakar ke dalam silinder melalui katup masuk yang terbuka.

sources.title: Four-stroke engine
sources.quote: In this stroke the intake valve must be in the open position while the piston pulls an air-fuel mixture into the cylinder by producing a partial vacuum (negative pressure) in the cylinder through its downward motion.

claims.text: Langkah kompresi menaikkan piston untuk memadatkan campuran udara dan bahan bakar dengan kedua katup tertutup.

sources.title: Four-stroke engine
sources.quote: In this stroke the piston compresses the air-fuel mixture in preparation for ignition during the power stroke (below). Both the intake and exhaust valves are closed during this stage.

claims.text: Langkah tenaga menghasilkan kerja mekanis dan dorongan akibat ekspansi gas pembakaran.

sources.title: Four-stroke engine
sources.quote: This stroke produces mechanical work from the engine to turn the crankshaft.

claims.text: Langkah buang mendorong sisa gas hasil pembakaran keluar melalui katup buang saat piston bergerak kembali ke atas.

sources.title: Four-stroke engine
sources.quote: During the exhaust stroke, the piston, once again, returns from B.D.C. to T.D.C. while the exhaust valve is open. This action expels the spent air-fuel mixture through the exhaust port.

sources.title: Otto cycle
sources.quote: The intake stroke and compression stroke require one rotation of the engine crankshaft. The power stroke and exhaust stroke require another rotation.

claims.text: Langkah hisap menurunkan piston untuk menarik campuran udara dan bahan bakar ke dalam silinder melalui katup masuk.

sources.title: Otto cycle
sources.quote: A mass of air (working fluid) is drawn into the cylinder, from 0 to 1, at atmospheric pressure (constant pressure) through the open intake valve, while the exhaust valve is closed during this process.

claims.text: Langkah kompresi menaikkan piston untuk memadatkan campuran tersebut, meningkatkan suhu dan tekanan sebelum percikan busi.

sources.title: Otto cycle
sources.quote: Piston moves from crank end (BDC, bottom dead centre and maximum volume) to cylinder head end (TDC, top dead centre and minimum volume) as the working gas with initial state 1 is compressed isentropically to state point 2

claims.text: Langkah tenaga menghasilkan dorongan ke bawah akibat ekspansi gas pembakaran bertekanan tinggi.

sources.title: Otto cycle
sources.quote: The increased high pressure exerts a force on the piston and pushes it towards the BDC. Expansion of working fluid takes place isentropically and work is done by the system on the piston.

claims.text: Langkah buang mendorong sisa gas hasil pembakaran keluar melalui katup buang.

sources.title: Otto cycle
sources.quote: As the piston moves from "BDC" (point 1) to "TDC" (point 0) with the exhaust valve opened, the gaseous mixture is vented to the atmosphere and the process starts anew.
